title: Louis's independence and unchanged character
summary: Mason says Louis left bands that restricted him and stayed happy-go-lucky.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: I remember a time he went with Fletcher Hanson... Uh... He went with Fletcher... He didn't stay there... Those... They came with Oliver... He went with Oliver for a while... And he didn't stay with Oliver's band... Because I found out that mostly... Uh... Particularly at that... At that time... Uh... The people wasn't, uh... They were not interested in... In letting a talent... Let you develop your talent... They want you to play what they wanted to play... And, of course, when they... That was not quite conductive to, uh... You establishing the kind of... Music you want to play... Yes. But Lewis was, uh... He was the most congenial person... I believe I... I ever met... And the one thing that, uh... Had good for him... In fact, over the years... He hasn't... He hasn't changed... No... He is, uh... He popularized his style... And he... Keep that same... Happy-go-lucky, uh... Uh... Attitude, you know... Like he always had... Yes.
